033/**
034 * An output that is designed for writing to a file.
035 */
036public interface FileOutput extends LogOutput {
037
038        /**
039         * Default file buffer size. This size was chosen based on Logbacks default.
040         */
041        public static final int DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE = 8192;
042
043        @Override
044        default OutputType type() {
045                return OutputType.FILE;
046        }
047
048        /**
049         * Creates a file output provider from lambda builder and uses the config properties
050         * from the returned log provider.
051         * @param consumer builder lambda.
052         * @return provider.
053         */
054        public static LogProvider<FileOutput> of(Consumer<FileOutputBuilder> consumer) {
055                return (s, c) -> {
056                        var builder = new FileOutputBuilder(s);
057                        consumer.accept(builder);
058                        builder.fromProperties(c.properties());
059                        return builder.build();
060                };
061        }
062
063        /**
064         * Create output from provider ref. This is mostly an internal call.
065         * @param ref file provider ref.
066         * @return provider.
067         */
068        public static LogProvider<LogOutput> of(LogProviderRef ref) {
069                return (s, c) -> {
070                        return provide(ref, s, c.properties());
071                };
072        }
073
074        private static LogOutput provide(LogProviderRef ref, String name, LogProperties properties) {
075                FileOutputBuilder b = new FileOutputBuilder(name);
076                var uri = ref.uri();
077                LogProperties combined;
078                if (uri.getQuery() != null) {
079                        combined = LogProperties.of(uri, b.propertyPrefix(), properties, ref.keyOrNull());
080                        String s = uri.toString();
081                        int index = s.indexOf('?');
082                        s = s.substring(0, index);
083                        uri = URI.create(s);
084                        uri = Paths.get(uri).toUri();
085                }
086                else {
087                        combined = properties;
088                }
089                b.uri(uri);
090                b.fromProperties(combined);
091                return b.build();
092        }
093
094        /**
095         * Creates file output.
096         * @param name name of output not file name.
097         * @param uri file uri.
098         * @param fileName file name.
099         * @param append whether or not to append to existing file.
100         * @param prudent logback prudent mode where files are locked on each write.
101         * @param bufferSize buffer size in bytes.
102         * @return file output.
103         * @throws UncheckedIOException if file not found.
104         */
105        @SuppressWarnings("resource")
106        @LogConfigurable(prefix = LogProperties.OUTPUT_PREFIX)
107        public static FileOutput of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name, @Nullable URI uri, @Nullable String fileName,
108                        @Nullable Boolean append, @Nullable Boolean prudent,
109                        @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE") Integer bufferSize) throws UncheckedIOException {
110                boolean prudent_ = prudent == null ? false : prudent;
111                boolean append_ = append == null ? true : append;
112                IOSupplier<FileOutput> supplier = () -> {
113                        File file;
114                        URI uri_ = uri;
115                        if (fileName != null) {
116                                file = new File(fileName);
117                                uri_ = file.toURI();
118                        }
119                        else if (uri_ != null) {
120                                file = new File(uri_);
121                        }
122                        else {
123                                throw new IOException("fileName and uri cannot both be unset.");
124                        }
125                        createMissingParentDirectories(file);
126                        FileOutputStream stream;
127                        try {
128                                stream = new FileOutputStream(file, append_);
129                        }
130                        catch (FileNotFoundException e) {
131                                throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
132                        }
133                        if (prudent_) {
134                                return new FileChannelOutput(uri_, stream.getChannel());
135                        }
136                        OutputStream s;
137                        Objects.requireNonNull(bufferSize);
138                        if (bufferSize <= 0) {
139                                s = stream;
140                        }
141                        else {
142                                s = new BufferedOutputStream(stream, bufferSize);
143                        }
144                        return new FileOutputStreamOutput(uri_, s);
145                };
146
147                return new ReopenableFileOutput(supplier);
148        }
149
150        /**
151         * Creates the parent directories of a file. If parent directories not specified in
152         * file's path, then nothing is done and this returns gracefully.
153         * @param file file whose parent directories (if any) should be created
154         * @return {@code true} if either no parents were specified, or if all parent
155         * directories were created successfully; {@code false} otherwise
156         */
157        private static boolean createMissingParentDirectories(File file) {
158                File parent = file.getParentFile();
159                if (parent == null) {
160                        // Parent directory not specified, therefore it's a request to
161                        // create nothing. Done! ;)
162                        return true;
163                }
164
165                // File.mkdirs() creates the parent directories only if they don't
166                // already exist; and it's okay if they do.
167                parent.mkdirs();
168                return parent.exists();
169        }
170
171}
172
173@FunctionalInterface
174interface IOSupplier<T> {
175
176        T _get() throws IOException;
177
178        default T get() throws UncheckedIOException {
179                try {
180                        return _get();
181                }
182                catch (IOException e) {
183                        throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
184                }
185        }
186
187}
188
189class ReopenableFileOutput implements ForwardingOutput, FileOutput {
190
191        private volatile FileOutput fileOutput;
192
193        private @Nullable LogConfig config;
194
195        private final IOSupplier<FileOutput> supplier;
196
197        public ReopenableFileOutput(IOSupplier<FileOutput> supplier) {
198                super();
199                this.supplier = supplier;
200                this.fileOutput = supplier.get();
201        }
202
203        @Override
204        public void start(LogConfig config) {
205                this.config = config;
206                fileOutput.start(config);
207        }
208
209        @Override
210        public @Nullable LogOutput delegate() {
211                return fileOutput;
212        }
213
214        @Override
215        public URI uri() throws UnsupportedOperationException {
216                return fileOutput.uri();
217        }
218
219        @Override
220        public OutputType type() {
221                return fileOutput.type();
222        }
223
224        @Override
225        public BufferHints bufferHints() {
226                return fileOutput.bufferHints();
227        }
228
229        @Override
230        public Status reopen() {
231                this.fileOutput.close();
232                this.fileOutput = supplier.get();
233                var config = this.config;
234                if (config != null) {
235                        this.fileOutput.start(config);
236                }
237                return Status.StandardStatus.OK;
238        }
239
240}
241
242class FileOutputStreamOutput extends LogOutput.AbstractOutputStreamOutput implements FileOutput {
243
244        protected FileOutputStreamOutput(URI uri, OutputStream outputStream) {
245                super(uri, outputStream);
246        }
247
248}
249
250class FileChannelOutput implements FileOutput {
251
252        protected final URI uri;
253
254        protected final FileChannel channel;
255
256        /*
257         * A log call can still be in flight (e.g. routed through SLF4J from a shutdown hook)
258         * after something outside the normal appender/publisher lifecycle - like Spring
259         * Boot's LoggingSystem.cleanUp() - has already closed this output directly. Once
260         * closed, write/flush become no-ops instead of throwing so that race does not surface
261         * as an uncaught exception on whatever thread is still trying to log. See the
262         * analogous fix for LogOutput.AbstractOutputStreamOutput (issue #323).
263         */
264        private final AtomicBoolean closed = new AtomicBoolean();
265
266        public FileChannelOutput(URI uri, FileChannel channel) {
267                super();
268                this.uri = uri;
269                this.channel = channel;
270        }
271
272        @Override
273        public URI uri() throws UnsupportedOperationException {
274                return uri;
275        }
276
277        @Override
278        public void write(LogEvent event, byte[] bytes, int off, int len, ContentType contentType) {
279                write(event, ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes, off, len), contentType);
280        }
281
282        @Override
283        public void write(LogEvent event, ByteBuffer buffer, ContentType contentType) {
284                if (closed.get()) {
285                        return;
286                }
287                try {
288
289                        // Clear any current interrupt (see LOGBACK-875)
290                        boolean interrupted = Thread.interrupted();
291
292                        FileLock fileLock = null;
293                        try {
294                                fileLock = channel.lock();
295                                long position = channel.position();
296                                long size = channel.size();
297                                if (size != position) {
298                                        channel.position(size);
299                                }
300                                channel.write(buffer);
301
302                        }
303                        catch (IOException e) {
304                                MetaLog.error(FileChannelOutput.class, e);
305                        }
306                        finally {
307                                if (fileLock != null && fileLock.isValid()) {
308                                        fileLock.release();
309                                }
310                                if (interrupted) {
311                                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
312                                }
313                        }
314                }
315                catch (IOException e) {
316                        throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
317                }
318        }
319
320        @Override
321        public void close() {
322                if (!closed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
323                        return;
324                }
325                try {
326                        channel.close();
327                }
328                catch (IOException e) {
329                        throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
330                }
331        }
332
333        @Override
334        public void flush() {
335                if (closed.get()) {
336                        return;
337                }
338                try {
339                        channel.force(false);
340                }
341                catch (IOException e) {
342                        throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
343                }
344        }
345
346        @Override
347        public WriteMethod bufferHints() {
348                return WriteMethod.BYTE_BUFFER;
349        }
350
351}
